gates.unit: node --test tests/famous-people.test.mjs and tests/famous-people-view.test.mjs, the named test and no other in its file

unit.name: Travis on the map at Béxar into the siege, where the Alamo draws him too
unit.expect: the roster's itineraries fit the engagements' clocks: nobody is on the campaign map while their own battle draws them
failed: the roster's itineraries fit the engagements' clocks: nobody is on the campaign map while their own battle draws them

unit.name: Travis falls somewhere other than the north battery
unit.expect: Travis falls at the north battery at his moment, and not a minute before; he lies there until the dead are carried out
failed: Travis falls at the north battery at his moment, and not a minute before; he lies there until the dead are carried out

unit.name: Bowie drawn falling like a man in a fight, not lying still on his cot
unit.expect: Bowie lies ill on his cot in his room on the south side, and lies still there when that barrack is carried; nothing of how is drawn
failed: Bowie lies ill on his cot in his room on the south side, and lies still there when that barrack is carried; nothing of how is drawn

unit.name: Crockett's death shown as the record, not as one account
unit.expect: Crockett fights through the assault and, as de la Peña tells it, is taken and killed before Santa Anna after it - labelled one account, the other accounts on screen
failed: Crockett fights through the assault and, as de la Peña tells it, is taken and killed before Santa Anna after it - labelled one account, the other accounts on screen

unit.name: Castrillón shot standing on his crate, not walking away
unit.expect: the church guns and their gunners fall together; Castrillón falls walking away at San Jacinto; Grant and Fannin are told, never drawn
failed: the church guns and their gunners fall together; Castrillón falls walking away at San Jacinto; Grant and Fannin are told, never drawn

unit.name: a named line allowed from somebody not drawn in its phase
unit.expect: every named line comes out of its speaker's own figure, drawn there at that minute, and none is reconstructed
failed: every named line comes out of its speaker's own figure, drawn there at that minute, and none is reconstructed

unit.name: the account says every man who fought was killed
unit.expect: Joe lives in every text: he fights beside Travis, takes cover and fires, comes out, is hurt and saved, is brought before Santa Anna and goes to Gonzales
failed: Joe lives in every text: he fights beside Travis, takes cover and fires, comes out, is hurt and saved, is brought before Santa Anna and goes to Gonzales

unit.name: Emily West's words without their stage direction
unit.expect: Emily West's picnic is a story told later: tradition, with a stage direction, never the record, never more than talk and a meal
failed: Emily West's picnic is a story told later: tradition, with a stage direction, never the record, never more than talk and a meal

unit.name: the line in the sand spoken as the record
unit.expect: the legends are spoken on the field as tradition, glossed as told later: the line in the sand, "stop that firing", the Napoleon of the West
failed: the legends are spoken on the field as tradition, glossed as told later: the line in the sand, "stop that firing", the Napoleon of the West

unit.name: the Twin Sisters unnamed on April 20
unit.expect: the Twin Sisters are named and fire where the record puts them: before the camp on April 20 under Neill, who is hit, and within two hundred yards on the 21st under Hockley
failed: the Twin Sisters are named and fire where the record puts them: before the camp on April 20 under Neill, who is hit, and within two hundred yards on the 21st under Hockley

unit.name: Houston hurt in the volley, before the charge
unit.expect: Houston rides with the line, is wounded in the charge at his minute, and lies wounded the next day; the Napoleon of the West comes out of Santa Anna
failed: Houston rides with the line, is wounded in the charge at his minute, and lies wounded the next day; the Napoleon of the West comes out of Santa Anna

unit.name: a family sees a famous person a hundred times further off than its people could
unit.expect: a family sees a famous person on the map only where its own people could, and nobody is drawn on the map and a field at once
failed: a family sees a famous person on the map only where its own people could, and nobody is drawn on the map and a field at once

unit.name: the Esparzas go in by the gate, not the church window
unit.expect: the Esparza family goes in with Gregorio through the church window on the evening of February 23, shelters in the sacristy through the siege and the assault, and Gregorio goes from beside them to his gun at the alarm
failed: the Esparza family goes in with Gregorio through the church window on the evening of February 23, shelters in the sacristy through the siege and the assault, and Gregorio goes from beside them to his gun at the alarm

unit.name: Ana Esparza killed after she is brought out of the church
unit.expect: every one of the Esparza family is spared: brought out after the fighting, taken to Músquiz's house, and at Béxar afterwards
failed: every one of the Esparza family is spared: brought out after the fighting, taken to Músquiz's house, and at Béxar afterwards

unit.name: Francisco Esparza walks to the Campo Santo carrying nothing
unit.expect: Francisco Esparza carries his brother Gregorio's body, wrapped, to the Campo Santo on the afternoon of March 6 - and nobody is carried who did not fall here first
failed: Francisco Esparza carries his brother Gregorio's body, wrapped, to the Campo Santo on the afternoon of March 6 - and nobody is carried who did not fall here first

unit.name: the engine lets a living man be carried away as a body
unit.expect: Francisco Esparza carries his brother Gregorio's body, wrapped, to the Campo Santo on the afternoon of March 6 - and nobody is carried who did not fall here first
failed: Francisco Esparza carries his brother Gregorio's body, wrapped, to the Campo Santo on the afternoon of March 6 - and nobody is carried who did not fall here first

unit.name: Ana Esparza's remembered words shown as the record
unit.expect: Ana's and Enrique's words are his own printed words of 1902, spoken as tradition out of their own figures; no reconstructed line speaks for the family
failed: Ana's and Enrique's words are his own printed words of 1902, spoken as tradition out of their own figures; no reconstructed line speaks for the family

unit.name: the Esparzas after the fall sent to every family, wherever its people are
unit.expect: a family sees a famous person on the map only where its own people could, and nobody is drawn on the map and a field at once
failed: a family sees a famous person on the map only where its own people could, and nobody is drawn on the map and a field at once

unit.name: the famous dead sent lying on the field in the phases before they fall
unit.expect: a fate is never sent before its minute, and nothing of a later phase is sent
failed: a fate is never sent before its minute, and nothing of a later phase is sent

unit.name: the famous drawn with no name under them
unit.expect: at the Alamo each famous person is named under their figure, Travis's words come out of him under his name, and Crockett taken carries the "one account" tag
failed: at the Alamo each famous person is named under their figure, Travis's words come out of him under his name, and Crockett taken carries the "one account" tag

unit.name: a stage direction left out of the bubble
unit.expect: at San Jacinto the Twin Sisters are named under the gun, Emily West's words carry their stage direction, and the Napoleon of the West comes out of Santa Anna
failed: at San Jacinto the Twin Sisters are named under the gun, Emily West's words carry their stage direction, and the Napoleon of the West comes out of Santa Anna

unit.name: the burial party drawn as a man walking alone, without the wrapped bundle
unit.expect: at the Alamo the Esparza family is drawn as a woman and children, Ana's words come out of her under her name, and Gregorio's body is carried as a wrapped bundle, never as a body
failed: at the Alamo the Esparza family is drawn as a woman and children, Ana's words come out of her under her name, and Gregorio's body is carried as a wrapped bundle, never as a body

browser.name: the famous drawn without their names
browser.expect: was not drawn with his name on the screen at the assault
browser.failure: travis was not drawn with his name on the screen at the assault

browser.name: Crockett's "one account" tag not drawn
browser.expect: The input did not match the regular expression /One account \(de la Peña\)/
browser.failure: The input did not match the regular expression /One account \(de la Peña\)/. Input:

browser.name: the stage direction dropped from the bubble
browser.expect: her words lost their stage direction or their tradition label
browser.failure: her words lost their stage direction or their tradition label

browser.name: the Esparza family drawn in the church without their names
browser.expect: was not drawn with a name in the church during the assault
browser.failure: ana-esparza was not drawn with a name in the church during the assault

browser.name: Gregorio Esparza's body carried as a man walking alone, no bundle
browser.expect: the body was not drawn as a wrapped bundle
browser.failure: the body was not drawn as a wrapped bundle: volunteer-march

browser.name: one steady frame of the map with the famous people stalled 100 ms
browser.expect: map with the famous people stalled before the siege
browser.failure: a steady frame of the student's map with the famous people stalled before the siege: 101.3 ms

browser.name: a famous person's sheet stalls 800 ms at its first draw
browser.expect: map stalled at a first draw before the siege
browser.failure: the Host's map stalled at a first draw before the siege: {"ms":3369.7,"ground":true,"firstSheets":19,"famous":4,"camera":"region","animation":false}

environment: Same computer: node --test, and local classroom servers with headless Chrome at 1366x768 and 1024x768.
